name: n8n Jobs Board Monitor (diffed, with DLQ and canary)

parameters.content:
## What this is

A monitor for the n8n Community **Jobs** board.

The measured position: roughly 5–8 genuine hiring posts a month, of which 2–3 are worth answering. Replies that get read arrive the **same day**. Thread position does not matter.

So the only variable worth moving is **how fast you find out** — and you cannot watch a forum from under a boiler.

**Run Demo** works offline. No account, no key, no network.

## The first run says nothing

On a cold start the seen-set is empty, so a naive diff would call all thirty existing topics new and fire thirty notifications at once.

The first run **seeds the set and stays silent**. There is a test for it.

Pinned announcements and `[FOR HIRE]` posts are dropped here too — 23 of those went up in the first 13 days of August and drew zero replies between them.

## Failure is kept, not lost

A notification that will not send is parked with its payload and the real error.

It **also releases the topic from the seen-set**, so the next poll finds it again. Without that, one thirty-second outage means the job you wanted is silently never seen.

## Canary — is anyone watching?

This checks whether the **monitor polled**, not whether it found anything.

That distinction matters: 2–3 addressable posts a month means weeks of no notifications is the *expected* state. Alarming on that would cry wolf constantly.

A poll that stopped happening is the real fault, and it is silent.
